CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 04 / 10

Consumer and producer surplus

Changes in surplus剩餘變化

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Use rectangles, triangles or discrete unit values to calculate and compare surplus as prices change. Separate gains to existing participants from gains to new participants.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

減價讓原有購買量每件都得益，也吸引額外購買。可分原有單位長方形與新增單位三角形；離散題逐件加總。

A lower price benefits existing buyers on all units they already buy and may attract additional purchases. Separate the existing-unit rectangle from the new-unit triangle. For discrete values, sum unit gains directly.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Linear demand: price falls 6→4 and Q rises 4→6. Existing gain=(6−4)×4=8; new-unit gain=½×2×2=2; total CS gain=10.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Price falls $2; existing purchases are 5 units. Gain on existing units alone? 舊購買量五件，減價兩元，舊單位收益？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
